label: Laws & the Legislature
summary: HB 657 died in the Senate Rules Committee on March 13, 2026. HB 797 and HB 803 took effect July 1, 2026. The 2027 regular session starts March 2, 2027.

label: Condo safety: SIRS & milestone inspections
summary: If a building's milestone inspection is due on or before December 31, 2026, the SIRS must be done "in no event" later than December 31, 2026.

label: Association websites & records
summary: Condos with 25+ units had to post key documents online by January 1, 2026; HOAs with 100+ parcels by January 1, 2025.

label: Board meetings & your right to speak
summary: Owners may speak on all designated agenda items. HOA members may speak at least 3 minutes on any item at membership meetings.

label: Running for your board
summary: For condo elections, your written notice of intent to run must be received 40 days before the election.

label: Nonprofit corporation law (Chapter 617)
summary: HB 797 revised officer duties, created a process for courts to remove directors, and updated meeting and notice procedures.
